claims.text: A Form groups the form fields below it so they can be validated together; its state object is a FormState, reached from outside through a GlobalKey<FormState> passed as the Form's key and read with currentState.
claims.source_hint: Flutter API docs: Form class, FormState, GlobalKey.currentState; SDK widgets/form.dart:35-43; cookbook forms/validation step 1

claims.text: GlobalKey.currentState returns the State of the widget in the tree that currently has the key, or null if no such widget is in the tree; Dart's `!` asserts a value is not null and throws at run time if it is.
claims.source_hint: Flutter API docs: GlobalKey.currentState; SDK widgets/framework.dart:186-195

claims.text: TextFormField wraps a TextField in a FormField, and DropdownButtonFormField wraps a DropdownButton in a FormField; each shows its validator's error message under itself.
claims.source_hint: Flutter API docs: TextFormField, DropdownButtonFormField (class docs); SDK material/text_form_field.dart:18-21, dropdown.dart:1783-1786

claims.text: A validator has type FormFieldValidator<T> = String? Function(T? value): it receives the field's current value and returns an error string to display, or null when the value is valid.
claims.source_hint: Flutter API docs: FormField.validator, FormFieldValidator typedef; SDK widgets/form.dart:477, 566-570; cookbook forms/validation step 2

claims.text: FormState.validate() validates every FormField descendant of the Form, and returns true only if there are no errors; the fields rebuild to report the results.
claims.source_hint: Flutter API docs: FormState.validate; SDK widgets/form.dart:352-362 and FormFieldState.validate 710-720 (setState in the field's own State)

claims.text: The text a field shows under itself is exactly the string its validator returned (TextFormField passes it to InputDecoration.errorText); the Form supplies no message of its own.
claims.source_hint: Flutter API docs: FormField.validator ('exposed by FormFieldState.errorText ... TextFormField uses this to override InputDecoration.errorText')
